what_the_interval_contains: Reference values: A = 100%, D = 0 years by construction
not_captured: Formulary placement, prior authorisation and cost-sharing are not captured

operational_meaning_of_public_reimbursem: NHI price listing (quarterly), which follows PMDA approval within 60 days (at most 90)
what_the_interval_contains: Interval is dominated by sponsor filing timing and PMDA review, not payer decision
not_captured: Drug loss: products never submitted in Japan are counted as not reimbursed

operational_meaning_of_public_reimbursem: Market launch (reimbursable from launch; price negotiated after AMNOG benefit assessment)
what_the_interval_contains: Interval reflects sponsor launch timing and EMA review
not_captured: Products withdrawn after a no-added-benefit rating (opt-out) count as not reimbursed only if withdrawn before 2023 in the Philipson data

operational_meaning_of_public_reimbursem: Publication in the Journal Officiel (reimbursement list)
what_the_interval_contains: Includes HAS assessment and CEPS negotiation
not_captured: Early access (accès précoce) use before listing is not counted

operational_meaning_of_public_reimbursem: Positive NICE recommendation / NHS England commissioning
what_the_interval_contains: Includes MHRA licensing (post-2021 national procedure) and NICE appraisal
not_captured: Cancer Drugs Fund (optimised) managed access counted as limited availability in W.A.I.T.; treatment in Philipson data not stated

operational_meaning_of_public_reimbursem: AIFA reimbursement status (class A/H) and Gazzetta Ufficiale publication
what_the_interval_contains: Includes EMA review, AIFA negotiation and regional formulary steps (not counted)
not_captured: Law 648/1996 and 5% fund access before listing not counted

operational_meaning_of_public_reimbursem: Public drug plans in provinces covering at least 50% of the population
what_the_interval_contains: Includes Health Canada review, CDA-AMC recommendation, pCPA negotiation and provincial listing
not_captured: Private insurance (the main payer for working-age Canadians) and Quebec INESSS route not counted; cohort overlaps the 2019-2022 PMPRB guideline uncertainty

what_the_interval_contains: Includes Swissmedic review and FOPH price setting
not_captured: Case-by-case reimbursement under Art. 71a-b KVV counted by W.A.I.T. as limited availability (individual reimbursement), presumably not in Philipson data; W.A.I.T. uses Swissmedic authorisation date

what_the_interval_contains: Includes TGA registration, PBAC recommendation, price negotiation and Cabinet approval for large items
not_captured: State hospital funding and special access schemes not counted

what_the_interval_contains: Includes MFDS review, HIRA evaluation (150 days) and NHIS negotiation (60 days)
not_captured: Risk-sharing agreements and pre-listing use not separately identified
